**Finding submitted — RENEWAL: deviation (walk-away), cured at the preferred level.**

- **Responsive clause:** Article IV TERM (p0049) is the sole renewal provision. Fees (p0050–p0060) set a fixed volume-band rate schedule for the Initial Period with no renewal uplift mechanic; no other renewal, extension or escalation language exists anywhere in the document (searches on "renew", "extension", "terminate", CPI/increase returned nothing further).
- **Problem:** a 36-month Initial Period extendable by a further **seven years at Licensor's sole option** — an imposed multi-year renewal with no Licensee consent, no non-renewal notice window and no term cap. This is walk-away territory and also contradicts sentences II and III of the same Article, which contemplate extension only by mutual written agreement.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** a single surgical replacement of the offending sentence so renewal is by mutual written agreement only, leaving all other Article IV mechanics verbatim. Conditional elements (12-month renewal term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder, uplift cap) are not triggered once renewal ceases to be automatic, and were mapped as already met on retained document language.
